statement: Let d ≥ 3 and let (Ud, h, L) be a connected oriented smooth initial-data exterior with nonempty compact smooth boundary T, complete with T included, with compact complement of exactly one Euclidean coordinate end. Write 2µ = Rh + (trh L)2 − |L|2 h, J = divh(L − (trh L)h). Suppose µ ≥ |J|h, µ, |J|h ∈ L1, and for some d − 2 2 < q0 < d − 2 assume h − δ = O6(r−q0 ), L = O5(r−1−q0 ). Assume that the ADM limits exist, with energy factor [2(d − 1)ωd−1]−1 and momentum factor [(d − 1)ωd−1]−1 applied to the Euclidean fluxes in (2.5)–(2.6), with g, K, τ replaced by h, L, trh L. Assume EADM > |PADM|, and suppose every component of T satisfies HT + trT L ≤ 0 with normal toward the end. Let A∗ > 0 be the infimum of the areas of full cuts in the sense of Definition 2.3, now in (U, h), with all components and contact with T counted. Then √ E2 ADM − |PADM|2 ≥ 1 2 ( A∗ ωd−1 )(d−2)/(d−1) . (2.15) No minimizing cut is required to be smooth or attained. No spin, symmetry, maximality, vacuum or stationary-development hypothesis is imposed.
